info.title: Designated Execution Service
info.description: Authenticated immutable approved-action dispatch, independent durable attempts and read-only recovery. Fresh wallet authority is required before provider effects. Unconfigured and disabled services fail closed; no generic signing, arbitrary transaction or gas-funding endpoint.

get.description: Authenticated discovery of provider IDs/revisions allowed for the pinned wallet origin. No credentials or sponsor bindings are exposed.

post.description: Signed exact immutable dispatch. A duplicate identity joins its original durable attempt; unknown provider effects never dispatch again. Fresh wallet owner/grant/KYC/consent/approval and durable handoff authority is checked after preparation, claim and immediately before effects.

oneOf.description: Exact immutable ApprovedExecutionPlan for the selected execution profile. ERC-3009 transfers or Safe calls, owner signature, sponsor, code pins, hashes and all action fields are independently validated against server policy and the current wallet authority callback before effects.
